statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-3784: curl could reuse an existing HTTP proxy connection that was set up with CONNECT to a server for a later request to the same server through the same proxy even when that request uses different proxy credentials, instead of creating a separate connection (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-3784.html). It affects curl 7.7 to 8.18.0 and was fixed in curl 8.19.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/5f13a7645e565c5c1a06f3ef86e97afb856fb364, which makes the proxy match in lib/url.c also compare the proxy user name and password for HTTP proxies, as it already did for SOCKS proxies. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. The 8.17.0-r1 and 8.18.0-r0 builds are curl releases from before the fix, and Alpine records CVE-2026-3784 as fixed in 8.19.0-r0 (https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/3.23-stable/main/curl/APKBUILD). In the 8.19.0-r0 build, on x86_64 and aarch64, the proxy_info_matches function in the static libcurl.a shipped in curl-static calls Curl_timestrcmp twice, the user name and password comparison the fix adds. So 8.19.0-r0, the first build of curl 8.19.0, is the first fixed build.

CVE-2026-3784: curl could reuse an existing HTTP proxy connection that was set up with CONNECT to a server for a later request to the same server through the same proxy even when that request uses different proxy credentials, instead of creating a separate connection (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-3784.html). It affects curl 7.7 to 8.18.0 and was fixed in curl 8.19.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/5f13a7645e565c5c1a06f3ef86e97afb856fb364, which makes the proxy match in lib/url.c also compare the proxy user name and password for HTTP proxies, as it already did for SOCKS proxies. Debian backported the fix to trixie in 8.14.1-2+deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-3784). The DHI curl packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie curl 8.14.1-2; the DHI Debian repository publishes three of them (the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 and two rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u7) for amd64 and arm64. Every published build is based on 8.14.1-2+deb13u5 or later, and the Debian changelog each one ships (in libcurl4t64 and libcurl3t64-gnutls, on both architectures) records the fix under 8.14.1-2+deb13u4, so the lowest published build, the rebuild of 8.14.1-2+deb13u5, is the fixed version used here. Earlier rebuilds of 8.14.1-2+deb13u3 and before, which this request also matches, are no longer published; they are based on Debian releases from before the fix and sort below the fixed version.
